key.name: touchpad-enabled
key.description: Allow Whoosh to respond to supported two-finger swipe and pinch gestures.

key.name: mouse-enabled
key.description: Allow mouse wheel events over a window title bar to trigger Whoosh actions.

key.name: mouse-button-enabled
key.description: Reserve a selected physical mouse button over title bars and recognize pointer movement as Whoosh gestures.

key.name: mouse-button
key.description: Selects the physical mouse button used for native Whoosh button-and-motion gestures.

key.name: mouse-sensitivity
key.description: Controls how far the pointer must move before a reserved-button mouse gesture is recognized.

key.name: touchscreen-enabled
key.description: Allow one-finger touchscreen drag and throw gestures from window title bars.

key.name: four-finger-touchscreen-enabled
key.description: Allow four-finger touchscreen pinch gestures to close or fullscreen windows.

key.name: overview-enabled
key.description: Allow Whoosh touchpad gestures over window previews in GNOME Overview.

key.name: dash-enabled
key.description: Allow Whoosh touchpad gestures over GNOME Dash and Dash to Dock application icons.

key.name: corner-tiling-enabled
key.description: Allow chained horizontal and vertical gestures to tile windows into screen corners.

key.name: animations-enabled
key.description: Animate Whoosh half-screen and corner tile operations.

key.name: touchpad-sensitivity
key.description: Controls how much touchpad movement Whoosh requires before recognizing a gesture.

key.name: corner-timing
key.description: Controls how quickly the vertical part of a corner-tiling gesture must follow the horizontal part.

key.name: animation-speed
key.description: Controls the duration of Whoosh tile animations.
